feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Two Iranians convicted of spying for their country after entering Britain illegally
articles.summary: Two Iranian nationals who arrived in the UK illegally have been found guilty of spying for their country in the first case of its kind.

articles.title: Under-fire Poundland owner 'among suitors' for footwear chain Dune
articles.summary: The beleaguered owner of Poundland is among the parties who have been considering offers for Dune, the British footwear retailer, even as its biggest UK high street asset teeters on the brink of collapse.

articles.title: Anti-migrant activist admits slashing boat with a knife in English Channel
articles.summary: An anti-immigration activist has pleaded guilty to criminal damage after using a knife to slash a migrant boat in the English Channel.

articles.title: Tim Westwood pleads not guilty to further sexual offence charges
articles.summary: Former Radio 1 DJ Tim Westwood has pleaded not guilty to further charges of sexual offences against two more women.

articles.title: Bomb alert at Calais train station disrupts Eurostar
articles.summary: A bomb alert at a French train station disrupted journeys including international travel, with Eurostar trains among those affected.

articles.title: Poundland secures extended deadline for possible rescue
articles.summary: Crisis-hit Poundland has secured an extended deadline for a potential rescue amid political pressure for a solvent sale of the chain.

articles.title: Sharp rise in deadly antibiotic-resistant infections
articles.summary: Hundreds of people are being diagnosed with potentially life-threatening antibiotic-resistant infections each week, new figures suggest.

articles.title: Poundland bosses meet to decide firm's future
articles.summary: The directors of crisis-hit Poundland have held a board meeting to decide the company's future, Sky News has been told.

articles.title: Economy grows 0.7% in third quarter but slowdown looms
articles.summary: The UK economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter of the year, according to early official figures confirming a boost from AI investment.

articles.title: Two Premier League managers sacked in a matter of hours
articles.summary: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick has been sacked.
